subject: sg
title: (R)SG.------TR.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 430 (MP(I)-4). SG (source initiation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: A-PR (all-purpose). From A-PR: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center) and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From DIS-C-CT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From IF-SPT: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From T-C-IMP: TRS (transition). From TRS: POL-DYM (political dynamics).
